note: The components' four bundled families (`../components/presentation.css`), as Kinetic ships them, and faces of our font library (fonts/, whose catalogue names each family's source) copied for the letters those lack; `../fonts.css` maps them onto the components' families. The font library's families a film may name in brand.font are listed with their faces, versions and designers in `library.json` (`tools/font-library.mjs` copies them and writes `../fonts.css`'s library section); each carries its licence text, `OFL-<id>.txt`.
